basePrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Hugmap guideline illustration sheet. Preserve EXACT silhouettes, facial expressions, poses, number/order/position of figures, framing, canvas aspect ratio, text and all geometry. Only update line colors and colored neck accessories. Mimo bird, Gen rabbit, Luke squirrel: body/clothing/ears/tail/wings/legs/eyebrows/mouth/beak outlines warm brown #A77C65; eye and nose fills and Luke spectacle frames darker #6B5143. Retain existing thin rounded line weights, no heavier lines. White bodies unchanged. All colored scarves/collars/bow ties/chest marks must be FLAT SOLID COLOR SHAPES WITH NO OUTLINE AND NO INTERNAL STROKES. Remove dark edging around neckwear including knots and ribbon ends. Preserve their exact silhouette, use negative space only if necessary to separate lobes. Mimo collar #FF511B, Gen and Luke neck scarves #D7C862, owl bow tie #7D2741. Chest logos #FF511B keep exact symbol shape and position. No gradient, shading or highlight inside colored accessories. Do not let body lines cross accessory color fills. Owl body lines remain unchanged. Activity tools retain thin outlines and original colors. If this is a props sheet change only its four neck accessories and glasses, leave all activity tools untouched. If turnaround sheet preserve labels, measurements and character alignment exactly. Keep original transparent background if present, otherwise original white background. No redesign, no extra elements.
